collectionsReport.note: Collected = payments received in the period, less reversals and refunds, plus money paid above what was owed (held as customer credit), less credit paid back. A payment taken from credit is not new money and is not counted again. Money on projects later cancelled still counts as collected. Owed now = unpaid on milestones whose event has happened (due date set), for customers and the bank; overdue = those whose due date is before today. Collection rate = of the milestones that fell due in the period, the share paid by now. The subsidy is never a receivable.
